signal: Clearspeed raised $60M Series D for its voice-based risk assessment platform, now used in 37 countries across 60+ languages, with a Zurich Insurance deployment

email.body1:
Kristian, saw Clearspeed raised its $60M Series D and is now live in 37 countries with deployments like Zurich Insurance.

Expansion at that scale usually puts more security-market accounts in play than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Clearspeed off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kristian, quick follow-up for Clearspeed.

Post-raise, expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can across the security markets you run. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your security team needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Kristian, last bit of proof for Clearspeed.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Clearspeed's reply rate likely compares to other security and risk software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kristian, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Expanding into new countries after a raise is its own kind of busy, and I get it.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your security-markets motion? I will tailor it to Clearspeed either way.
